messages:
morgan: Received pen-test findings from RedTeamInc. Critical path: service-account misbind -> potential lateral RBAC elevation. Secondary: KMS audit sampling disabled on one ring and missing service-to-service audit entries. Need quick remediation + sealed evidence for retest. Can we claim owners?

elaine: I can own RBAC remediation. Plan: narrow permissions, remove broad bindings from svc-infra, and do a canary attach to svc-infra-canary. Will post terraform diff.

raj: I'll handle KMS audit exports and confirm no rotations during capture. I'll pull GCP and AWS KMS trails, key metadata, and CloudTrail/CloudAudit slices for 30 days around the incident.

carmen: I'll create the evidence bucket with immutability settings and generate checksums + GPG signatures for each artifact. Will include capture commands in README.

ops-oncall: Standby for the window. If rollout causes control-plane failures, page SRE. Prepare rollback: reapply pre-iam snapshot.

morgan: Proposed window: Tue 2024-09-17 15:00 UTC, 60m. Sequence: pre-snapshots -> apply RBAC canary -> monitor 20m -> collect evidence -> seal uploads -> vendor retest slot.

elaine: Canary plan: snapshot IAM `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json > pre-iam.$TS.json`, apply `infra.limited` role to svc-infra-canary, monitor errors (5xx, PERMISSION_DENIED), then roll. Rollback is reapply of pre-iam JSON.

raj: KMS export commands (examples): GCP: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=30d --format=json > kms-gcp-30d.ndjson` AWS: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-08-15 --end-time 2024-09-17 --query Events > kms-aws-30d.json`. Will not rotate keys until evidence captured.

carmen: Evidence manifest will include filename, sha256, capture command, operator, timestamp, and GPG fingerprint. Example: `kms-gcp-30d.ndjson, <sha256>, gcloud logging read ..., raj, 2024-09-17T15:45:00Z, 0xF1E2D3C4`.

morgan: Vendor requires sealed evidence and operator signatures. Carmen, enable object versioning and set bucket lifecycle to prevent edits; provide presigned GET links to vendor.

carmen: Will enable versioning and upload with `gsutil retention` + `gpg --detach-sign`. Will post presigned URLs after upload.

ops-oncall: Alerting: create a short-lived log metric to watch for spike in `PERMISSION_DENIED` and SetIamPolicy events. If errors exceed baseline by 5% for 10m, auto-rollback.

elaine: I'll attach monitoring alert and add oncall to the runbook. PR ETA: today EOD with tfplan.

raj: I'll start exports after canary is stable and upload artifacts to `gs://pt-evidence-4165`.

carmen: I'll generate signatures and manifest and put README_FOR_VENDOR.md in the bucket.

morgan: Final checklist: elaine (RBAC PR + pre/post snapshots), raj (KMS exports + key metadata), carmen (bucket + checksums + signatures), ops-oncall (rollback ready). React with :thumbsup: if you accept owners and window.

elaine: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

carmen: :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: on standby

morgan: Thanks. I'll lock the window and coordinate the retest slot. Keep updates in this thread for the final manifest link.
